results.name: Medicine Ball Jumps
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down.
Jump up explosively, pushing the ball overhead.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.
tips: Land with your knees bent.
Keep your chest up.
results.description: Medicine Ball Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Shoulders.

results.name: MTS Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the MTS Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl machine to fit your height. Kneel on the machine with your left knee on the knee pad and the right leg extended, securing your ankle under the padded lever. Rest your chest against the chest pad.
Hold onto the handles for stability and keep your back straight.
Curl your leg by bending your knee and pulling your heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl your leg up and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: MTS Iso-Lateral Kneeling Leg Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Calves.

results.name: Multi Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand on the platform of the multi-hip machine and position the padded lever against the outside of your thigh. Grip the handles firmly and maintain an upright posture with a slight bend in your standing leg.
Engage your glutes and push the working leg laterally against the resistance, lifting it to the side as far as possible.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, switch legs, and repeat.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning to the side during the movement.
Engage your core muscles to help stabilize your hips and maintain balance.
Move your leg in a controlled manner to avoid swinging and ensure full glute engagement.
results.description: Multi Hip Abduction is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Multi Hip Adduction
instructions: Stand on the multi-hip machine with the pad on the inside of your working leg.
Hold the handles and stand tall.
Pull your leg in across the front of your body against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso still.
Move slowly through the full range.
results.description: Multi Hip Adduction is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Multi Hip Glute Extension
instructions: Stand on the platform of the multi-hip machine, turn to one side, and position the padded lever behind your thigh. Hold the handles firmly in front of you and lean slightly forward at the hips while keeping your spine straight.
Extend your leg backward in a controlled motion until your leg is in line with your torso.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, switch legs, and repeat.
tips: Keep a slight bend in the standing knee to improve balance and reduce joint stress.
Focus on squeezing your glutes at the top of the extension for maximum activation.
Avoid swinging the leg or using momentum; perform the movement slowly and under control.
results.description: Multi Hip Glute Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Lower Back.

results.name: Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Dumbbell Goblet Squats
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet close together, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down, letting your knees travel forward.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor or lower.
Drive back up and repeat.
tips: The raised heels shift the work onto your quadriceps.
Keep your chest up.
results.description: Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Dumbbell Goblet Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl With Partner
instructions: Kneel on a mat with a partner holding your ankles down.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Slowly lean forward, resisting with your hamstrings for as long as possible.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push back up and repeat.
tips: Lower as slowly as you can.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips straight.
results.description: Nordic Hamstring Curl With Partner is an advanced single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Calves.

results.name: Normal Squat Smith Machine
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and step under it with the bar on your upper back.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of you.
Unrack the bar and squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive back up and repeat.
tips: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Re-rack the bar by twisting it onto the hooks.
results.description: Normal Squat Smith Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Pistol Squat to Box
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench, with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down slowly onto the box on one leg.
Touch the box lightly without relaxing.
Drive up through the standing leg to stand, then switch legs.
tips: Lower the box height as you get stronger.
Hold your arms forward for balance.
results.description: Pistol Squat to Box is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Plate Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Step one leg behind and across your body into a curtsy position.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
results.description: Plate Curtsy Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Abductors.
